notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI covers the observable behavior of Benilla's world_map module: Map.dbc is loaded as a catalog (directory + LoadingScreenID via DbcReader), the current map is authoritative session state, SMSG_NEW_WORLD performs the cross-map transition in one transaction (TearDownWorldContent, ADT streamer re-targeted to the new map directory, resident centre reset), and the loading screen resolves the map's real art through Map.dbc -> LoadingScreens.dbc.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Benilla's MapChange broadcast is an internal cache-eviction signal (the teleport asset-leak fix); MSUI's TearDownWorldContent on the same edge is the architectural equivalent. A map with no Map.dbc/WDT identity degrades with a log line rather than a crash, matching Benilla's degraded posture.
